verdict.rationale: Groq's docs confirm audio transcription (Whisper models via groq-gh-2) and vision input support through the Responses API (text and image inputs, groq-docs-13), extending beyond pure text chat. However, there is no evidence of image-generation models or text-to-speech/audio-generation capability on the platform. missing for 10: image-generation model support, audio-generation/TTS support, independent hands-on confirmation of multimodal calls.
